what.text: This page follows Venezuelans in Ecuador whom UNHCR counts as other people in need of international protection, a group separate from refugees.
At the end of 2025 there were 432888 people in this group, 7.2% of all Venezuelans in it worldwide.
Only 2908 Venezuelans in Ecuador were counted as refugees that year.

why.text: The sources here don't say why people left Venezuela.
UNHCR's figures describe the scale of the movement, not its causes.

when.text: UNHCR's figures for this group in Ecuador start in 2018 at 256265 and peak at 503882 in 2021.
Since then the figure has been somewhat lower each year up to 2025.

how.text: These are year-end totals reported to UNHCR, and UNHCR adds notes to some of the figures.
Ecuador's share of all Venezuelans in this group was 9.9% in 2018 and 7.2% in 2025.
The sources don't say how people travelled or where in Ecuador they live.
